key_findings: Oxaliplatin (3 μM) increased ROS, cytoplasmic cytochrome C, Nrf2 nuclear translocation, GRP78, Iba1 and CD86 in BV-2 microglia.
Mg, Mn and Zn salts prevented oxaliplatin-induced oxidative stress and microglial activation; only Mg prevented the GRP78 (ER stress) increase.
